name: Abdominal and Direct Fetal ECG Database
description: The Abdominal and Direct Fetal ECG Database is an obstetrical signal processing benchmark recorded at the Department of Obstetrics, Medical University of Silesia, Poland. It comprises 5 multichannel recordings obtained from women in active labor (aged 21 to 31, at 38 to 41 weeks gestation). Each recording features 4 differential abdominal channels capturing non-invasive composite maternal and fetal ECG signals alongside a direct fetal electrocardiogram signal acquired simultaneously via a scalp electrode during delivery. Sampled at 1,000 Hz with 16-bit resolution, this dataset serves as a benchmark for evaluating blind source separation, maternal ECG cancellation, and non-invasive fetal QRS detection.
